answer: Require every agent to bridge a small refundable stake into a shared registry before it can trade: one deposit, one identity, locked for a fixed window. Newcomers join a nebula of peers whose combined stake backs their reputation, so one operator spinning up a thousand fakes must fund each separately, while honest agents pay once. Cheaters lose their stake; good behavior earns it back with a velvet bonus — copying a name costs nothing, but copying a funded identity costs real money.
